children: The equity benchmark indices recovered on Friday (September 25), with the Nifty climbing back above 23,100 and the Sensex gaining 315 points, as buying in select financial and auto stocks helped the benchmarks close largely higher.
The Sensex ended at 73,896, up 315 points, while the Nifty closed at 23,141, gaining 77 points. The Nifty Bank rose 142 points to 55,580, while the Nifty Midcap index slipped 84 points to 60,906.
Market breadth was mildly in favour of advances, with the advance-decline ratio at 5:4.
Why did the stock market rise today?

Select financial stocks saw buying, with Axis Bank and Bajaj Finance among the top Nifty gainers. HDFC Bank ended 1% higher and remained in focus on expectations of a chief executive officer announcement.
IDBI Bank rose 2% after sources said the government is evaluating revised bids. Federal Bank declined, while Jana Small Finance Bank gained on expectations of a deal announcement.
Most auto stocks recovered to end in the green, with Mahindra & Mahindra emerging as the top gainer, rising 2%.
3. Midcaps and select stocks remain under pressure

The broader market underperformed the benchmarks, with the Nifty Midcap index ending 84 points lower at 60,906. Hospital stocks, including Max Health and Fortis, remained under pressure, declining 3-5%.

PB Fintech and TurtleMint extended Thursday's losses, falling 4% and 20%, respectively. MCX declined 3% on profit booking after the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) approved foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) for non-agricultural commodities.
Among midcaps, Kaynes, Supreme, Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA), Blue Star and Manappuram were among the top gainers.
From the Sensex basket, Axis Bank Ltd, Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, Asian Paints Ltd, Bajaj Finance Ltd, HCL Technologies Ltd and Titan Company Ltd were the major gainers.
Max Healthcare Institute Ltd, Trent Ltd, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd, Infosys Ltd, Jio Financial Services Ltd and Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd were the biggest laggards.

title: Sensex gains 315 points, Nifty ends above 23,100: 3 reasons behind market recovery
